request.style: English, traditional gospel spiritual, soaring female lead vocal with gospel choir, gospel piano, Hammond organ, tambourine, hand claps, stomping drums, bass, jubilant and rousing, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Pharaoh's chariots behind us and the sea before our face
Israel cried out to the LORD, there was no hiding place
Was it for want of graves in Egypt that you brought us here to die
But Moses answered all the people with his staff held high

[Pre-Chorus]
Do not be afraid
Stand firm and see the deliverance the LORD will bring you today
The LORD will fight for you
You need only be still

[Verse]
Moses stretched his hand out and the east wind blew all night
The waters were divided and the pillar gave them light
They walked through on dry ground with a wall on either hand
And when the morning came they were standing on the farther sand

[Chorus]
I will sing to the LORD, for he is highly exalted
Horse and rider he hurled into the sea
The LORD is my strength and my song
He has become my salvation

[Bridge]
Through the sea on dry ground
Through the sea on dry ground
With a wall of water on their right and on their left
He is my God, and I will praise him
The God of my father, and I will exalt him

[Chorus]
I will sing to the LORD, for he is highly exalted
Horse and rider he hurled into the sea
The LORD is my strength and my song
He has become my salvation

[Outro]
Horse and rider he hurled into the sea
The LORD is my strength and my song
